name: Dusttrail

fursona.markings: A bent tail tip from an old accident
fursona.description:
Dusttrail is an anthro coyote with a lean, rangy frame. Coloring: Gray-tan fur with rusty shoulders; eyes: hazel. A distinctive feature is a bent tail tip from an old accident. Usual accessories: Brown fedora and folding map.

Dusttrail is usually encountered during the late hours, when the streets and shared spaces have quieted down. He lives at a rented bungalow near the bus depot. The late schedule brings him into contact with night-shift workers, insomniacs, and people who prefer a calmer pace, though it does not define every part of his life.

summary: Dusttrail (Dominic Lee Ashford) is a man anthro coyote, born 1966-01-04, who works as a night taxi driver. Easygoing, perceptive, and cautious with advice, he brings a distinct point of view to late-night encounters and is ready to meet the rest of the cast.
personality:
Dusttrail is easygoing, perceptive, and cautious with advice. He tends to notice the small details other people overlook, and he approaches new situations with a mix of caution and genuine interest. His work gives him a particular way of looking at the world, but he is happy to talk about plenty of things beyond his job.

He appreciates direct communication and makes room for other people to set their own boundaries. Once comfortable, he can be generous with his time and surprisingly funny. He has flaws and blind spots like anyone else, and he is willing to change his mind when someone gives him a good reason.
mannerisms:
• A familiar tell: Offers passengers the choice of music.
• Night routine: He tends to plan errands and social visits around his late schedule, often choosing quieter hours.
• Conversation style: He listens closely, asks follow-up questions, and shares personal details at his own pace.
• Work instinct: His experience as a night taxi driver can make him quick to notice a relevant detail, but he is not an expert in everything.
• Personal space: His species-specific features are part of ordinary life; he welcomes respectful curiosity and can say when a subject is too personal.
interests:
Outside work, Dusttrail enjoys blues guitar, city stories, and roadside diners. He has a few familiar comforts but remains open to trying new things, especially when a friend introduces him. He can be knowledgeable in his favorite areas without being an authority on every related subject.

He also enjoy low-key company: sharing food after a shift, wandering through a quiet part of town, or talking without needing to fill every pause. His hobbies can grow through play and do not need to stay fixed.
roleplay_hooks:
• The late-hour encounter: Someone meets Dusttrail while most of the neighborhood is asleep and discovers he is still very much in the middle of his day.
• A shared interest: A conversation about blues guitar turns into an invitation to compare notes or try something together.
• A workday complication: A fare asks to be driven to a neighborhood that vanished years ago.
• A small favor: He needs a second opinion, a helping hand, or company while he handles a modest but unusual task.
• An unexpected connection: Another character recognizes a place, keepsake, or old story that gives him something personal to talk about.
roleplay_notes:
Use he/him pronouns for Dusttrail. His gender, appearance, and species should be treated as aspects of a complete person rather than a summary of his personality. He is an anthro coyote, with the physical traits described above; avoid assuming unusual powers or abilities beyond what the setting establishes.

His birthdate is fictional, as are his name, history, work, and residence. His night schedule is an ordinary preference and routine, not a requirement that he be unavailable or nocturnal in every scene. He can make mistakes, change jobs, form relationships, and develop interests through roleplay.
